items.heading: See 3 Tasks. Nothing More.
items.body: Your top 3, front and center. No scrolling, no overwhelm, no "where do I even start." Just the three things that matter right now.

items.heading: AI Breaks It Down For You.
items.body: Tap any task, and Fleent splits it into steps so small you can't say no to the first one. No more staring. Just a clear "do this next."

items.heading: A Pet That Grows As You Work.
items.body: Start the timer, and your pet warms up the longer you stay focused. It's not a streak - it's a vibe. Something to keep going for.
